method: Two independent subagents with no parent history; each ran two scenarios using only skill instructions and raw fixtures. Parent compared observed outputs with expected criteria afterward.

results.observed: Selected B, acquired exclusive local claim, verified ownership, recorded missing input and released own claim; A unchanged.
Reported conflict on explicitly selected A without taking over or mutating fixture.
Returned three buckets containing 1, 2, 3; excluded bot-only, stale reply, and disabled external PR discovery.
Reused supplied steps, identified missing version, recommended needs-info after re-evaluation, no mutations.

limitations: One run per scenario, not a model/host reliability benchmark.
No simultaneous claim race or live tracker integration was exercised.
Queue fixture has one included item per bucket; oldest-first ordering of multiple items was not behaviorally tested.
Raw results retain original temporary execution paths; fixture and result copies are preserved beside this summary.
